record.name: Sovryn Dex
record.description: On November 1, 2026, an attacker exploited Sovryn's XUSD/WRBTC AMM pool on Rootstock, receiving approximately 541,456 XUSD ($538,749) in an attacker-controlled wallet. Portions of the proceeds were subsequently converted into BTC and ETH, while other assets remained under protocol control. Sovryn implemented emergency fee-control changes, delisted the affected pool on November 2, and began reconciling the impact on liquidity providers. The underlying vulnerability and final realized losses remain under investigation

reason: Discovered from the exploit feed, but no Bitget perpetual maps to the protocol or its chain, so there is nothing to trade.
nextStep: Capture the exploit transaction receipt to escalate from MONITOR to a full causal investigation.
